CRITICAL.name: Stripe Webhook Handler
requires: HMAC signature verification (fail-closed)
Replay protection via timestamp validation
Event idempotency via event ID deduplication
State machine (pending → processing → processed/failed → dead_letter)
Atomic transaction: event → entitlement sync
Max attempts + dead-letter queue
Timeout protection (30s)
CRITICAL.notes: Already production-hardened, 12-point checklist verified. Webhook is outside auth scope (external Stripe system).

CRITICAL.name: Entitlement Sync Transaction
risks: User granted access without payment confirmation
Payment processed but access not granted
Dual access to same tier (race condition)
Revocation doesn't trigger on payment failure
requires: Atomic transaction: webhook event + entitlement update
Workspace + stripe_customer_id lookup validation
Price ID validation against subscription tier
Rollback on any failure (payment success → entitlement sync must succeed)
Audit event emission for entitlement changes
CRITICAL.notes: Tied to webhook processing. Already implements atomic transactions.

CRITICAL.name: Billing Upgrade Checkout
CRITICAL.business_impact: Initiate Stripe checkout for plan upgrades
risks: Duplicate checkout sessions created (same payment twice)
requires: Idempotency via idempotency-key header
Workspace isolation: only owner can upgrade workspace
Stripe session deduplication (one session per workspace per period)
Atomic workspace state update: pending_checkout flag
Timeout: invalidate old sessions after 24h
CRITICAL.notes: Check if idempotency-key handling is implemented. If not, add deduplication.

CRITICAL.name: Subscribe Webhook Handler
CRITICAL.business_impact: Confirm subscription activation, grant beta access
risks: State loss: confirmation event dropped silently
requires: Signature verification (workspace secret)
Replay protection via timestamp + nonce
Event idempotency deduplication
State machine (pending → subscribed/cancelled)
Atomic entitlement sync on confirmation
CRITICAL.notes: Similar to Stripe webhook. Already implements required safety.

HIGH.name: Decision Execute (State Transition)
HIGH.business_impact: Execute approved decision (transition to EXECUTED state)
risks: Decision executed when not in APPROVED state
requires: Idempotency via idempotency-key + deduplication store
State machine enforcement: verify APPROVED state before execution
Atomic state transition: decision.status + audit event + side effects
Workspace scoping: only workspace members can execute
Concurrency protection: test-and-set or pessimistic lock
HIGH.notes: Irreversible operation. Executing twice = corrupted workflow. Must implement idempotency.

HIGH.name: Action Complete (State Transition)
risks: Duplicate completion: same action marked done twice
Completion timestamp corrupted (retried with new timestamp)
Owner attribution lost (second request attributes to different user)
Dependent decisions don't trigger (side effects lost)
requires: Idempotency via idempotency-key
State machine: verify PENDING before completion
Atomic: action.status + completed_at + owner + audit event
Workspace scoping: only members can complete workspace actions
Side effects: trigger dependent decisions atomically

HIGH.name: Engagement Condition Update (Cascade Trigger)
HIGH.business_impact: Update business condition, trigger re-evaluation of recommendations
risks: Condition updated but re-evaluation not triggered
Workspace isolation: update wrong workspace's condition
requires: Idempotency via idempotency-key (prevent double condition change)
Workspace scoping: only members can update engagement conditions
Atomic: condition update + re-eval trigger + audit event
State validation: new condition must be valid for current phase
Cascade protection: re-eval must not modify condition (prevent loops)
Audit trail: previous condition preserved
HIGH.notes: Cross-aggregate write (engagement → condition → recommendation). Must prevent loops.

HIGH.name: Intervention State Change (Governance Cascade)
risks: Invalid state transition allowed (skip required phases)
Recommendations not archived on phase change
Actions not transitioned to new phase state
requires: State machine: enforce valid transitions (allowlist)
Workspace scoping: only authorized members can transition
Atomic: state change + recommendation archive + action migration + audit
Cascade trigger: re-evaluate recommendations for new phase
Audit trail: previous phase + timestamp + actor
Validation: phase prerequisites met
HIGH.notes: Governance-critical. Invalid transitions break entire engagement flow.

MEDIUM.name: Evidence Validation
MEDIUM.business_impact: Mark evidence as trusted/validated (affects finding credibility)
risks: Duplicate validation: same evidence marked trusted twice
Workspace isolation: validate wrong workspace's evidence
requires: Idempotency: prevent double validation
Audit trail: who validated, when, evidence state before/after
Workspace scoping: only members of workspace can validate
Cascade: update finding credibility based on evidence validation
MEDIUM.notes: Audit-critical. Validation state affects finding trust.

MEDIUM.name: Finding Creation
MEDIUM.business_impact: Create new finding with evidence links, trigger recommendations
risks: Duplicate findings created (same evidence linked twice)
Evidence orphaned (finding deleted but evidence not cleaned)
Workspace isolation: create finding in wrong workspace
requires: Cross-aggregate validation: evidence exists in workspace
Idempotency: prevent duplicate findings
Atomic: finding creation + evidence link + recommendation trigger
Workspace scoping: only members can create findings
Audit trail: finding history
MEDIUM.notes: Cross-aggregate write. Must validate evidence before linking.

MEDIUM.name: Recommendation Rerank
risks: Duplicate rerank: same priorities applied twice
Workspace isolation: rerank wrong workspace's recommendations
requires: Idempotency: prevent duplicate rankings
Audit trail: original vs new order
Workspace scoping: only members can rerank
Validation: all recommendations exist in workspace
MEDIUM.notes: Priority changes affect business decisions. Audit trail essential.

LOW.name: Engagement Acknowledge
LOW.business_impact: Workspace acknowledges engagement (triggers notifications, entitlement checks)
requires: Idempotency: prevent duplicate notifications
Workspace scoping
LOW.notes: Operational risk. Duplicate email is annoying but not critical.

LOW.name: Webhook Test
LOW.business_impact: Admin testing custom webhook (sends test event to customer endpoint)
risks: Duplicate test events sent to customer
Workspace isolation: test webhook from wrong workspace
requires: Idempotency: prevent duplicate test events
Workspace scoping: only admins of workspace can test
LOW.notes: Admin tool. Duplicate test event is minor issue.
